summary.intent: Fix a noisy Stop-hook error from gsd-context-monitor.js and a blank statusline, update GSD to the latest version, remove stale worktrees, and begin planning phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT) of the v2.0 milestone.
summary.outcome: Statusline fixed by renaming hook to .cjs; GSD reinstalled cleanly to 1.6.0 (restoring missing gsd-context-monitor.js and the full hook/command set); all three worktrees removed; phase 61 research completed at HIGH confidence with four planning-critical findings ready for the planner.

repo: cipher-box has `"type": "module"` in package.json — all .js files are treated as ESM by Node, so any CommonJS hook must use the .cjs extension to override this
GSD hooks are gitignored (`.gitignore:55` pattern `.claude/hooks/gsd-*`) and are not tracked; losing them requires re-running the GSD installer, not a git restore
The main-tree GSD install was a broken fragment (missing gsd-tools.cjs, gsd-context-monitor.js, update.md, and the file manifest); complete installs only existed in throwaway worktrees on 1.4.3
GSD is installed via `npx @opengsd/gsd-core` and the .gitignore comment pinned 1.6.0 as the expected version

Phase 61: CONTEXT.md states test path `packages/crypto/__tests__/build-node-aad.test.ts` but vitest's `include: ['src/**/*.ts']` only discovers `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/` — planner must use the src path

`scripts/check-vector-parity.sh` has a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` array; adding `tests/vectors/crypto/node-aad.json` to it is a required CI task, otherwise the parity-check step fails even when both Rust and TS tests pass

`sealAesGcmAad` mints a fresh random IV and cannot produce fixed KAT output; the D-01b fixed-IV vector must target `encryptAesGcmAad`/`decrypt_aes_gcm_aad` directly, mirroring how `aes-gcm.json` targets `encrypt_aes_gcm` not `seal_aes_gcm`
`uuid` crate (v1.23.4) is not currently in the workspace Cargo.toml or `crates/crypto/Cargo.toml` — phase 61 must add it
Zero AAD consumers (`additionalData`/`aad`/`associated_data`) exist anywhere in the codebase; phase 61 is purely additive

code.finding: Pattern `.claude/hooks/gsd-*` gitignores all GSD-managed hooks, making them unrecoverable via git and requiring a full GSD reinstall when missing
Hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` array must be updated whenever a new KAT vector file is added; omitting this causes CI failure independent of whether Rust and TS tests pass

workflow: When a project has `"type": "module"`, rename Node hook scripts to `.cjs` rather than rewriting them to ESM — smaller change, same fix
`git worktree remove` cleans up both the working directory and git metadata but preserves the branch; branches must be deleted separately if unwanted
When a GSD install is broken/fragmented the update workflow itself cannot run (no gsd-tools.cjs); use `npx @opengsd/gsd-core@VERSION -- gsd-core --claude --local` directly to reinstall
GSD worktrees are disposable — they do not need to be kept in sync with the main-tree version after an update

friction: The GSD reinstall prompt was interactive and required a manual keep/remove decision for two stale fragment files; the workflow had no non-interactive flag and had to be re-run with a resolution workaround
The main-tree GSD install was silently broken — it had enough structure to register hooks in settings.local.json but not enough to run them, so the error fired every turn with no obvious trigger
CONTEXT.md contained an incorrect test path (`packages/crypto/__tests__/`) that would have caused silent test-discovery failure in CI had the researcher not caught it
The worktree copy of gsd-context-monitor.js had a divergent hash from the manifest, making it unusable as a restore source and requiring a full reinstall
open_items: Branches `fix/phase60-safety-tail` and `fix/fuse-delete-share-revocation` still exist in the repo after worktree removal — may need cleanup
Phase 61 planning not yet complete: researcher returned, but planner (Opus) and plan-checker (Sonnet) have not yet run

Three open design questions from the researcher: (1) single `node-aad.json` with keyed arrays vs two files, (2) hand-freeze vectors vs extending `generate-test-vectors.ts`, (3) `CryptoError` variant name for AAD validation (recommended: `InvalidAadInput`)
The `statusline.cjs` rename is a tracked file change in the repo that should be committed before the next push
